subject.title: Bookstore Project & Provider Lookup Project
details: Bookstore Project (https://github.com/RossJiao/bookstore-project): Built an end-to-end e-commerce platform for books. Implemented book search, order placement, unique order ID generation, and eBook placeholder creation. Integrated email confirmation with order details and file attachments using Gmail SMTP.

Provider Lookup Project (https://github.com/RossJiao/provider-lookup-project): Developed an interactive command-line tool to search healthcare providers. Integrated with the official NPPES NPI Registry API to fetch real-time provider data. Displays provider details including NPI number, name, address, specialty, and license.
MIT 6.0001 Python Lectures: Completed Lectures 1 through 15.

notes: Bookstore Project completed with full email integration and GitHub documentation.
Provider Lookup Project completed using live NPPES NPI Registry API.
NPI (National Provider Identifier) is a unique identification number for covered healthcare providers in the US.
